analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 31.0, entering oversold territory, continuing decline from 35.0 five days ago. MACD histogram worsening to -1.3014, maintaining dead cross. ADX at 24.5, in early trend formation stage, but -DI (32.8) is dominant over +DI (13.2). Volume ratio to 5-day average is 0.71, indicating contraction. Positioned 10.2% above 52-week low of $25.89. Current price $30.78 is near swing support at $30.17. 5-day high $35.99, 20-day high $47.91 indicate downtrend. 5-day low $30.03, 20-day low $30.03 show no Higher Low confirmation. Approaching Bollinger Band lower band at $30.25. Weekly RSI 39.8, weekly MACD histogram -1.1250, both in weak territory. Despite market-wide QQQ +1.3% rise, this stock shows continued weakness. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
